01 / THE MECHANISM

Meme energy.
Treasury discipline.

VAULTAIL separates the meme from the machinery. The token stays a standard SPL asset. A dedicated fee stream fills a treasury that follows a public risk policy.

The goal is simple: make the path from a Solana swap to an options position easy to inspect—and hard for a trading key to abuse.

Permission to trade.
Never permission to take.

Automation is useful only when its authority is narrow. VAULTAIL’s proposed design separates ownership, execution, and emergency control.

05 / STRAIGHT ANSWERS

Good questions.
No smoke.

Does every transfer pay a tax?＋

No. The proposed structure uses eligible pool-creator or treasury-owned liquidity fees rather than taxing normal wallet transfers.

Can the trading bot withdraw funds?＋

No. Its intended session key can place and cancel approved trades only. Withdrawals remain under multisig control.

Can the treasury lose money?＋

Yes. Options can expire worthless, spreads can reach maximum loss, and bridge, stablecoin, liquidity, contract, and operating risks remain.

Do holders own the treasury?＋

Not under this concept. Holding $VTAIL does not guarantee a distribution, return, redemption right, or ownership of treasury assets.

Why cross chains at all?＋

Solana hosts the token and fee activity. Ethereum hosts the proposed options-account custody path. CCTP moves native USDC between them.

RISK DISCLOSURE

$VTAIL is a proposed experimental and highly speculative crypto asset. Options trading may result in partial or total loss of treasury capital. The system would also involve token, liquidity, bridge, stablecoin, smart-contract, custody, execution, and operational risks. Nothing here is financial, investment, legal, or tax advice. No return, distribution, token-price increase, or preservation of capital is promised. Availability may be restricted by jurisdiction.
